notes: `Stepper("", value: $autoBackupMaxCountLocal, in: 3...50)` is SwiftUI's own range clamp -- it is UI-layer only. setAutoBackupMaxCount(_:for:) (AppViewModel+ServerControls.swift:820-825) itself performs no validation or clamping on whatever Int it is handed; the 3...50 bound exists purely because the editor's Stepper control cannot itself produce a value outside that range, not because the model enforces it. A config file hand-edited to a value like 1 would be accepted as-is by the model layer.
